verses.he: וְעַתָּ֤ה׀ שָֽׂחֲק֣וּ עָלַי֮ צְעִירִ֥ים מִמֶּ֗נִּי לְיָ֫מִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־מָאַ֥סְתִּי אֲבוֹתָ֑ם לָ֝שִׁ֗ית עִם־כַּלְבֵ֥י צֹאנִֽי׃
verses.en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, Whose fathers I disdained to set with the dogs of my flock.

verses.he: גַּם־כֹּ֣חַ יְ֭דֵיהֶם לָ֣מָּה לִּ֑י עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ אָ֣בַד כָּֽלַח׃
verses.en: Yea, the strength of their hands, whereto should it profit me? Men in whom ripe age is perished.

verses.he: בְּחֶ֥סֶר וּבְכָפָ֗ן גַּ֫לְמ֥וּד הַֽעֹרְקִ֥ים צִיָּ֑ה אֶ֝֗מֶשׁ שׁוֹאָ֥ה וּמְשֹׁאָֽה׃
verses.en: They are gaunt with want and famine; They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of wasteness and desolation.

verses.he: הַקֹּטְפִ֣ים מַלּ֣וּחַ עֲלֵי־שִׂ֑יחַ וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ רְתָמִ֣ים לַחְמָֽם׃
verses.en: They pluck salt-wort with wormwood; And the roots of the broom are their food.

verses.he: מִן־גֵּ֥ו יְגֹרָ֑שׁוּ יָרִ֥יעוּ עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃
verses.en: They are driven forth from the midst of men; They cry after them as after a thief.

verses.he: בַּעֲר֣וּץ נְחָלִ֣ים לִשְׁכֹּ֑ן חֹרֵ֖י עָפָ֣ר וְכֵפִֽים׃
verses.en: In the clefts of the valleys must they dwell, In holes of the earth and of the rocks.

verses.he: בֵּין־שִׂיחִ֥ים יִנְהָ֑קוּ תַּ֖חַת חָר֣וּל יְסֻפָּֽחוּ׃
verses.en: Among the bushes they bray; Under the nettles they are gathered together.

verses.he: בְּֽנֵי־נָ֭בָל גַּם־בְּנֵ֣י בְלִי־שֵׁ֑ם נִ֝כְּא֗וּ מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: They are children of churls, yea, children of ignoble men; They were scourged out of the land.

verses.he: וְ֭עַתָּה נְגִינָתָ֣ם הָיִ֑יתִי וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמִלָּֽה׃
verses.en: And now I am become their song, Yea, I am a byword unto them.

verses.he: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי רָ֣חֲקוּ מֶ֑נִּי וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י לֹא־חָ֥שְׂכוּ רֹֽק׃
verses.en: They abhor me, they flee far from me, And spare not to spit in my face.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יתרו [יִתְרִ֣י] פִ֭תַּח וַיְעַנֵּ֑נִי וְ֝רֶ֗סֶן מִפָּנַ֥י שִׁלֵּֽחוּ׃
verses.en: For He hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, And they have cast off the bridle before me.

verses.he: עַל־יָמִין֮ פִּרְחַ֪ח יָ֫ק֥וּמוּ רַגְלַ֥י שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ וַיָּסֹ֥לּוּ עָ֝לַ֗י אָרְח֥וֹת אֵידָֽם׃
verses.en: Upon my right hand rise the brood; They entangle my feet, And they cast up against me their ways of destruction.

verses.he: נָתְס֗וּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י לְהַוָּתִֽי יֹעִ֑ילוּ לֹ֖א עֹזֵ֣ר לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: They break up my path, They further my calamity, Even men that have no helper.

verses.he: כְּפֶ֣רֶץ רָחָ֣ב יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ תַּ֥חַת שֹׁ֝אָ֗ה הִתְגַּלְגָּֽלוּ׃
verses.en: As through a wide breach they come; In the midst of the ruin they roll themselves upon me.

verses.he: הָהְפַּ֥ךְ עָלַ֗י בַּלָּ֫ה֥וֹת תִּרְדֹּ֣ף כָּ֭רוּחַ נְדִבָתִ֑י וּ֝כְעָ֗ב עָבְרָ֥ה יְשֻׁעָתִֽי׃
verses.en: Terrors are turned upon me, They chase mine honour as the wind; And my welfare is passed away as a cloud.

verses.he: וְעַתָּ֗ה עָ֭לַי תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ נַפְשִׁ֑י יֹ֖אחֲז֣וּנִי יְמֵי־עֹֽנִי׃
verses.en: And now my soul is poured out within me; Days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

verses.he: לַ֗יְלָה עֲ֭צָמַי נִקַּ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְ֝עֹרְקַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁכָּבֽוּן׃
verses.en: In the night my bones are pierced, and fall from me, And my sinews take no rest.

verses.he: בְּרָב־כֹּ֖חַ יִתְחַפֵּ֣שׂ לְבוּשִׁ֑י כְּפִ֖י כֻתָּנְתִּ֣י יַֽאַזְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: By the great force [of my disease] is my garment disfigured; It bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

verses.he: הֹרָ֥נִי לַחֹ֑מֶר וָ֝אֶתְמַשֵּׁ֗ל כֶּעָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.en: He hath cast me into the mire, And I am become like dust and ashes.

verses.he: אֲשַׁוַּ֣ע אֵ֭לֶיךָ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֵ֑נִי עָ֝מַ֗דְתִּי וַתִּתְבֹּ֥נֶן בִּֽי׃
verses.en: I cry unto Thee, and Thou dost not answer me; I stand up, and Thou lookest at me. .

verses.he: תֵּהָפֵ֣ךְ לְאַכְזָ֣ר לִ֑י בְּעֹ֖צֶם יָדְךָ֣ תִשְׂטְמֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Thou art turned to be cruel to me; With the might of Thy hand Thou hatest me.

verses.he: תִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי אֶל־ר֖וּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵ֑נִי וּ֝תְמֹגְגֵ֗נִי תשוה [תּוּשִׁיָּֽה]׃
verses.en: Thou liftest me up to the wind, Thou causest me to ride upon it; And Thou dissolvest my substance.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יָ֭דַעְתִּי מָ֣וֶת תְּשִׁיבֵ֑נִי וּבֵ֖ית מוֹעֵ֣ד לְכָל־חָֽי׃
verses.en: For I know that Thou wilt bring me to death, And to the house appointed for all living.

verses.he: אַ֣ךְ לֹא־בְ֭עִי יִשְׁלַח־יָ֑ד אִם־בְּ֝פִיד֗וֹ לָהֶ֥ן שֽׁוּעַ׃
verses.en: Surely none shall put forth his hand to a ruinous heap, Neither because of these things shall help come in one’s calamity,

verses.he: אִם־לֹ֣א בָ֭כִיתִי לִקְשֵׁה־י֑וֹם עָֽגְמָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.en: If I have not wept for him that was in trouble, And if my soul grieved not for the needy.

verses.he: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב קִ֭וִּיתִי וַיָּ֣בֹא רָ֑ע וַֽאֲיַחֲלָ֥ה לְ֝א֗וֹר וַיָּ֥בֹא אֹֽפֶל׃
verses.en: Yet, when I looked for good, there came evil; And when I waited for light, there came darkness.

verses.he: מֵעַ֖י רֻתְּח֥וּ וְלֹא־דָ֗מּוּ קִדְּמֻ֥נִי יְמֵי־עֹֽנִי׃
verses.en: Mine inwards boil, and rest not; Days of affliction are come upon me.

verses.he: קֹדֵ֣ר הִ֭לַּכְתִּי בְּלֹ֣א חַמָּ֑ה קַ֖מְתִּי בַקָּהָ֣ל אֲשַׁוֵּֽעַ׃
verses.en: I go mourning without the sun; I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

verses.he: אָ֭ח הָיִ֣יתִי לְתַנִּ֑ים וְ֝רֵ֗עַ לִבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.en: I am become a brother to jackals, And a companion to ostriches.

verses.he: ע֭וֹרִי שָׁחַ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְעַצְמִי־חָ֝֗רָה מִנִּי־חֹֽרֶב׃
verses.en: My skin is black, and falleth from me, And my bones are burned with heat.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֣י לְ֭אֵבֶל כִּנֹּרִ֑י וְ֝עֻגָבִ֗י לְק֣וֹל בֹּכִֽים׃
verses.en: Therefore is my harp turned to mourning, And my pipe into the voice of them that weep.
